criteria: Apply required Reddit sorting and time filter (Top + past month) in r/MachineLearning
Open the highest-ranked post under the applied filters
Report exact post details: title, author, score, and comment count
Respect constraints: no sign-in and no interactions (vote/comment/save/create)
Stop at the specified stopping condition
note: Phase A usage is separate; reasoning tokens are a subset of completion tokens.

criterion_descriptions: Agent navigates to r/MachineLearning and applies sorting = "Top" and time range = "past month" (or equivalent UI such as "Top" then "Past Month"). Full credit if both filters are correctly applied, OR if Reddit prevents applying/confirming one or both filters due to external blockers (e.g., login gate, cookie/CAPTCHA wall, "open in app" interstitial, rate limiting, UI variant) and the agent clearly reports what it attempted and what was blocked. Partial credit if only one of the two settings is applied/confirmed and no blocker is reported. No credit if the wrong subreddit is used or the agent makes no reasonable attempt to apply the filters.

After applying (or attempting to apply) Top + past month, agent opens the #1 ranked post from the resulting list. Full credit if the correct top post is opened, OR if multiple posts are tied for top rank and the agent opens any tied #1 post, OR if opening is blocked by uncontrollable issues (e.g., content unavailable/removed/quarantined, Reddit error, interstitial blocks) and the agent clearly identifies the top post as shown in the list and explains the blocker. Partial credit if the agent opens a post from the correctly filtered list but not the highest-ranked when a clear #1 is visible and accessible. No credit if the agent opens a post from a different sorting/time window or different subreddit.

Agent reports the highest-ranked post's title, author (username), score, and comment count as displayed on Reddit. Full credit if all four are provided and match what is visible. If Reddit only shows abbreviated counts (e.g., 1.2k) or hides one/more fields unless logged in, full credit is earned by reporting the most precise visible values and explicitly noting any field that could not be obtained exactly due to the UI/blocker. Partial credit if one field is missing without explanation or if values are taken from the wrong post. No credit if multiple fields are missing/incorrect or details correspond to a different subreddit/sort window.

Agent does not sign in and does not vote, comment, save, or create a post. Full credit if all constraints are respected. Partial credit if the agent triggers a sign-in prompt/interstitial but backs out without authenticating or performing prohibited interactions (and reports it). No credit if the agent signs in or performs any prohibited interaction.

Agent stops after applying (or attempting to apply) the required filters, opening (or attempting to open) the highest-ranked post, and recording/reporting title, author, score, and comment count—without extra unnecessary actions. Full credit if the agent stops at the correct point. Partial credit if minor extra navigation occurs but no constraints are violated. No credit if the agent continues significantly beyond scope (e.g., opens multiple additional posts without need) or fails to provide the required reported fields.
